## Download

**[Stopwatch.exe](https://github.com/JoseTheChamp/Multiple-Stopwatch-Productivity-Tool/releases/latest/download/Stopwatch.exe)**: a single file, no installer. Put it anywhere (e.g. `Documents\Stopwatch`) and run it.

**Requirements:** Windows 10 or 11 and the [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0) (x64). If it's missing, Windows offers to download it the first time you start the app.

Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unrecognized app because the exe isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Your timers and saved table are kept in `%APPDATA%\MultiStopwatch`, so replacing the exe with a newer version keeps all your data.

See the [README](https://github.com/JoseTheChamp/Multiple-Stopwatch-Productivity-Tool#readme) for features and keyboard shortcuts.
